newsitem.title: FRANCE: Carrefour sees 15-20 pct profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Carrefour sees 15-20 pct profit rise.

text.p: Carrefour Supermarch SA chairman Daniel Bernard said on Thursday the retail group expects a rise in net attributable profit of 15 to 20 percent for 1997 and a 10 percent rise in sales excluding tax to around 170 billion.
Bernard told the annual shareholders meeting on Thursday the group expected to increase investments in 1997 to more than 13 billion francs.
"Our goal is to strengthen our position among the retail leaders worldwide," he said.
Carrefour reported net attributable profit of 3.12 billion francs for 1996 on sales of 154.9 billion.
